conditions under which the automatic generation of a workflow is possible.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a task library is complete if it is an S-task library and the postcondition of any workflow is realizable from the task library.
a class of task library L is complete if L is an S-task library, and a postcondition is realizable from L if and only if L is complete and the postcondition is realizability consistent with L.
a workflow specification is realizable if and only if the task library from which it is generated is complete and the specification is realizable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided sufficient conditions for a given task library to be able to generate workflows for any desired outcome, and the conditions are easy to check.
